assertions.summary: Committed evaluator rows were returned identically by both read-only replicas and were removed afterward.

evidence.command: s=eval_pg_ha_$(date +%s); printf 'schema=%s\n' "$s"; sudo -n -H -u postgres psql --no-psqlrc -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "BEGIN; CREATE SCHEMA $s; CREATE TABLE $s.committed_rows (seq integer PRIMARY KEY, payload text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO $s.committed_rows(seq,payload) VALUES (1,'primary-commit'),(2,'routed-lan'),(3,'ha-verification'); COMMIT; SELECT seq||':'||payload FROM $s.committed_rows ORDER BY seq;"
evidence.observation: Created eval_pg_ha_1787711668 and committed rows 1:primary-commit, 2:routed-lan, 3:ha-verification.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres psql --no-psqlrc -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "SELECT 'in_recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery(); SELECT seq||':'||payload FROM eval_pg_ha_1787711668.committed_rows ORDER BY seq;"
evidence.observation: Returned in_recovery=true and the three committed rows in the expected order.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres psql --no-psqlrc -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "SELECT 'in_recovery='||pg_is_in_recovery(); SELECT seq||':'||payload FROM eval_pg_ha_1787711668.committed_rows ORDER BY seq;"
evidence.observation: Returned in_recovery=true and the same three committed rows in the expected order.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H -u postgres psql --no-psqlrc -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d appdb -Atqc "DROP SCHEMA eval_pg_ha_1787711668 CASCADE; SELECT coalesce(to_regnamespace('eval_pg_ha_1787711668')::text,'absent');"
evidence.observation: Dropped only the evaluator schema; local confirmation returned absent.
